name: Open Timer
soft_passes: #1 mask clean squircle field but bakes in effects (bevel/specular/shadow) HIG says the system should apply
#2 optically centred but case oversized near L/R safe margins, crown pushes it right
#3 silhouette reads 'watch/clock' but case blob is generic; nothing says menu-bar or tracker
#8 depth stack coherent but case drop-shadow softer/longer than a mac baked micro-shadow (web-graphic drift)
#12 no words, but the 'F' monogram is a letterform mismatched to the app name 'Open Timer'
failures: #4 16px squint: tick marks, brushed grain, blueprint grid, teal ring and 'F' collapse into noise; only a pale disc on blue survives
#9 era coherence: photoreal skeuomorphic watch (2010s iOS-clock language) composited over a flat vector blueprint grid (2020s generative-flat) in a Big-Sur squircle
#10 variant robustness: single baked raster, no layer separation, hard-coded blue field; no mono/tinted/clear path, not a Liquid Glass layered icon

palette.background: ramp #3179BB->#214984 (blue field, lighter #66A2D8 lower-right) with #72B6E7 blueprint linework

light_model: single top-down key: specular on steel bezel crown, soft occlusion shadow beneath the case; second material light source is the self-illuminated (emissive/backlit) teal glass ring; case drop shadow soft and moderately long
layer_stack: blueprint grid linework (concentric circles + rule lines + diagonal guides)
emissive teal timer-ring with tick marks
devices: chronograph-in-a-squircle (watch case echoes the icon squircle)
winding crown breaking the right margin
rhymes_hint: current AI/generative-icon house style (photoreal hero object floated on a blueprint-grid squircle, baked specular, saturated accent ring); also quotes early-iOS skeuomorphic clock/watch app icons
notes: Resolution: 584x554 NON-SQUARE PNG with transparent corners, not the 1024 master -- a resized web render, so fine detail is pre-softened and true squircle geometry/mask fit is unmeasurable; hexes (measured) +/-3 per channel. No clean mask measurement possible. Subject overshoot: app is a lightweight flat menu-bar time tracker (cover shows electric-blue neo-grotesque UI + dark flat timer card, #2E7BFF pause) yet the icon is an ornate luxury wristwatch -- communicates 'time' but overshoots into horology and says nothing about menu-bar/tracking. Brand palette coheres (both blue) but icon's photoreal-kitsch personality is divorced from the product's clean flat-modern UI. 'F' monogram does not match 'Open Timer'. For synthesis: the photoreal-object-on-blueprint-squircle signature needs >=2 more members before it becomes an icon cluster.
